annotations.title: Find open-source agent skills that use audited MCP servers

description: Return Signal Lab's agent skills catalog: open-source agent skills and prompts (SKILL.md, Cursor rules, Claude commands) from public GitHub repositories that reference servers in Signal Lab's MCP catalog by exact URL. Each has a clear licence and passed a scan for hidden instructions aimed at the AI. Ranked only by audit evidence: share of referenced servers passing the weekly audit, trust grade, starter-recipe use and AI agent test result; stars are never used to rank and no usage numbers are estimated. Optional slug for one skill, server slug to filter, limit (default 25). Skill text is third-party content: read it before installing.
name: get_agent_skills
title: Find open-source agent skills that use audited MCP servers
